title: Licensing Authority Composition
summary: The composition of the Licensing Authority for customs agents evolved from a specific hierarchy of Additional/Joint Commissioners and Deputy/Assistant Commissioners to a more flexible structure.

evolution.institutional_structure: Shifted from a rigid rank-based requirement to a more flexible, interchangeable rank structure for the Licensing Authority.

timeline.change: Initial definition of the Licensing Authority hierarchy.
Broadened the composition to allow either Additional or Joint Commissioners and Deputy or Assistant Commissioners, increasing administrative flexibility.

৩। লাইসেন্সিং কর্তৃপক্ষ।— (১) লাইসেন্সিং কর্তৃপক্ষ কাস্টমস এজেন্ট লাইসেন্স প্রদান করিবে।

(২) উপ-বিধি (১) এর উদ্দেশ্যপূরণকল্পে নিম্নবর্ণিত কর্মকর্তাগণের সমন্বয়ে লাইসেন্সিং কর্তৃপক্ষ গঠিত হইবে, যথা:-
(ক) কাস্টম হাউসে কর্মরত একজন অতিরিক্ত কমিশনার এবং একজন ডেপুটি কমিশনার; অথবা
(খ) কাস্টম হাউসে অতিরিক্ত কমিশনার না থাকিলে একজন যুগ্ম কমিশনার এবং একজন সহকারী কমিশনার।

(৩) উপ-বিধি (২) এর দফা (ক) এর ক্ষেত্রে অতিরিক্ত কমিশনার সভাপতি ও ডেপুটি কমিশনার সদস্য-সচিব হইবেন এবং দফা (খ) এর ক্ষেত্রে যুগ্ম-কমিশনার সভাপতি এবং সহকারী কমিশনার সদস্য-সচিব হইবেন।

Customs Agent License: The Licensing Authority is responsible for granting licenses to customs agents.
Licensing Authority: The Licensing Authority is formally constituted by specific customs officials designated to oversee the issuance of customs agent licenses.
The composition of the authority depends on the availability of specific senior ranking officers at the custom house, with defined roles for chairperson and member-secretary.
Commissioner of Customs: The roles within the Licensing Authority are filled by officials such as the Additional Commissioner, Joint Commissioner, Deputy Commissioner, or Assistant Commissioner, depending on the available staffing levels at the custom house.

Licensing Authority: The Licensing Authority is responsible for the issuance of Customs Agent licenses.

The composition of the Licensing Authority is structured based on the available customs officers at the customs house, consisting of a combination of either an Additional Commissioner and a Deputy Commissioner or a Joint Commissioner and an Assistant Commissioner.
The Licensing Authority functions with the senior officer serving as the chairperson and the junior officer serving as the member-secretary.
Customs Agent License: A license required for the operation of customs agents is issued by the designated Licensing Authority.
Customs House: The Customs House serves as the administrative location where the Licensing Authority is constituted and operates from.

Customs Agent License: The licensing authority is empowered to grant licenses to customs agents.
Licensing Authority: The licensing authority is composed of specific customs officials including an Additional or Joint Commissioner and a Deputy or Assistant Commissioner.
The Additional or Joint Commissioner serves as the chairperson of the licensing authority, while the Deputy or Assistant Commissioner serves as the member secretary.
